text:
maria: heads-up, onboarding sampleapp CI started failing on macOS runner today, native gem ext fails to build
kevin: can you paste the error output? usually missing dev headers or CLT change
maria: ```
extconf.rb:16:in `require': cannot load such file -- mkmf (LoadError)
checking for clang... no
*** extconf.rb failed ***
```
jen: that looks like Xcode CLT / ruby dev headers missing on the image
maria: CI matrix runs 3.1 and 3.2, failure only reproducible on hosted mac image for 3.2
sam: is this the same macos-latest runner the GH actions image updated last week? could be related
maria: possible. For a quick workaround I added a step to install ruby dev tooling via brew in branch maria/onboard/ci-macos-gems
kevin: for linux we add build-essential and ruby-dev; for mac a one-liner `xcode-select --install` is flaky in CI, so `brew install ruby@3.2` works
maria: added that to the job, CI passed locally, pushing
maria: one more thing — noticed our sampleapp auth helper uses short-lived tokens. CI retries during the build sometimes hit a 401 mid-stream and the ruby client doesn't recreate the request cleanly
jen: ah, auth refresh + streaming bug? other SDKs rebuild the request on refresh; rb-sdk might be reusing the keep-alive socket
sam: which endpoint pattern? streaming chat or single-request generation?
maria: streaming chat. Flow: initial request gets 401 -> token refresh -> retry reuses socket -> server rejects -> stream dies
kevin: that sounds like a parity gap we should fix quickly; open a tiny PR to ensure request object is rebuilt on auth refresh and that we close/renew the connection for streaming paths
maria: PR opened: https://git.example.com/redwood/rb-sdk/pulls/91
devex-bot: PR 91 opened by maria in rb-sdk — reviewers requested: kevin, jen
kevin: I'll review. Add a unit that simulates 401 then success and a smoke integration using sampleapp streaming flow
jen: small nit — add a guard so we only force-reconnect for 401-triggered refresh, not for normal transient errors
maria: added test + smoke job in sampleapp CI and pinned mac runner image for the branch while we triage
sam: can we also add a one-line in quickstart about mac prerequisites so new devs don't hit this? a short "macOS prerequisites" section mentioning brew deps
maria: good idea — I'll add that to docs/devex/quickstarts and file follow-up issue
maria: follow-up issue: https://git.example.com/redwood/devex/issues/215
kevin: LGTM on the PR after test tweak, merge when green
maria: merged, CI green in main. will follow-up with short devex note about token-refresh+streaming best practices
jen: thanks for the quick fix :party:
maria: thanks everyone :heart:
